subject: Handoff: Harborlane Health — Exec summary & owner matrix
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@harborlane.health>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@harborlane.health>, Procurement <procurement@harborlane.health>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Harborlane Health — Exec summary & owner matrix

Team —

Quick handoff for Harborlane Health (mid-market, ~1.2M ARR initial commit, clinical workflows + patient messaging). Signed today after final pricing approval. Key points below and attachments (SOW v3, implementation timeline).

What Harborlane expects in the first 60 days:
- Prod-ready pilot with selective routing for three critical clinics (Cardiology, Primary Care, Behavioral Health)
- Integration with their Okta SSO + data retention 7 years per reqs
- Latency budget: 150ms p95 on generation for clinician workflows; we agreed to an initial SLA for Dedicated Capacity.

Risks / known blockers:
- They need completed SOC 2 evidence before full rollout (procurement flagged). I attached the filled questionnaire; procurement will come back with any follow-ups.
- Internal security asked about HSM/KMS mapping; technical lead (Miguel) will share their key rotation policy.

Owners (proposed):
- Primary CS lead: Marissa Cole (post-sale owner and escalation)
- Implementation engineer: Vivek Kulkarni (deployment, infra reqs, capacity sizing)
- S2C to CS PM: Karthik Iyer (SOW clarifications, acceptance criteria)
- CS Ops / scheduling / acceptance tests: Tessa Morgan

Immediate asks (next 48 hours):
1) Marissa — confirm owners above and availability for a 30-min kickoff next week (Wed/Thu preferred).
2) Vivek — review the attached timeline and call out any quota/GPU concerns.
3) Karthik — confirm acceptance criteria in section 3 of the SOW; flag anything that deviates from standard templates.
4) Samira/Miguel — identify 2-3 pilot users we should include in the kickoff and confirm Okta SAML contact.

Attachments: Harborlane_SOW_v3.pdf, Harborlane_Implementation_Timeline.xlsx, RL-Security-Questionnaire-completed.pdf

Thanks — aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, tessa_morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira@harborlane.health>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@harborlane.health>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Harborlane Health — Exec summary & owner matrix

Thanks Aditya — great summary. Welcome Samira and Miguel, excited to partner.

Confirming owners: I accept primary CS lead. I'll run the kickoff and own the post-go-live checklist. Vivek & Karthik — I'll assign detailed tasks below once we align on dates.

Proposed kickoff cadence:
- Week 0 (Kickoff): alignment on scope, SSO owner, pilot user list, success metrics
- Week 1-3 (Integration): Okta SAML, environment provisioning, model variant selection + quantization plan
- Week 4-6 (Pilot): clinician pilot, monitoring dashboard baseline, token-cost controls in place

Pre-kickoff asks for the Harborlane team (Samira / Miguel):
- Please upload the two pilot user emails to the shared Drive link listed below.
- Confirm whether Harborlane prefers our managed Dedicated deployment or private VPC. We discussed Dedicated in the call but want written confirmation.

Internal to-do (I'll handle the items marked):
- Marissa: schedule kickoff (will propose Wed 14 Jul or Thu 15 Jul) — ON IT
- Vivek: run a quick infra sizing pass against the timeline (Vivek, plz ping with any changes)
- Karthik: review SOW acceptance criteria and call out any edits — please send redlines by EOD Fri
- Tessa: I need the acceptance test template and a proposed monitoring dashboard owner

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal CS Manager | Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jul 7, 2027 at 10:05 AM marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — great summary. Welcome Samira and Miguel, excited to partner.

Quick notes from CS Ops perspective — thanks for the heads-up. A few operational notes before kickoff:

1) Acceptance test template: I attached the template to the Drive link and copied the three mandatory acceptance criteria we agreed on: authentication, end-to-end latency, data retention behavior (exports/restores).
2) Monitoring owner: recommend assigning to "CS Monitoring" (internal rotation) until we have a named Harborlane contact. Vivek — can you own setting up the initial Grafana dashboard and alerts? I will provide the dashboard template.
3) Dedicated capacity sizing: Vivek, please confirm GPUs and burst policy — if we need >4 T4-equivalents in peak, ops needs to pre-approve budget.

Action items assigned (owner / due):
- Vivek Kulkarni / 2027-07-12: infra sizing + provisional instance config (Vivek)
- Karthik Iyer / 2027-07-09: SOW redlines submitted (Karthik)
- Marissa Cole / 2027-07-08: kickoff invite sent to internal + Harborlane stakeholders (Marissa)
- Samira/Miguel / 2027-07-08: pilot user list + Okta SAML contact (Harborlane)

Tessa Morgan
CS Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Handoff: Harborlane Health — Exec summary & owner matrix

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. A few clarifications from my side:
- Procurement: the DocuSign link is sent; they asked for a 30-day invoice net; finance to confirm but we committed in the contract.
- On Dedicated vs Private: Samira — please confirm preference; we have a 2-week runway to switch to Private if they choose that path (additional infra lead time).
- I'll remain looped as AE for escalations; Marissa, please escalate to me for any scope creep or major SLA asks.

Closing note: Marissa / Tessa — if you can lock kickoff time by EOD tomorrow, I will update the HubSpot milestone and send the intro to procurement as needed.

Aditya
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
